sections.section_title: LPDMA channels with peripheral early termination
sections.text_helper: Section 14.3.6 "LPDMA channels with peripheral early termination" in chapter 14 (Low-power direct memory access controller (LPDMA)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 387.
sections.section_content:
A LPDMA channel, if implemented with this feature, can support the early termination of the
data transfer from the peripheral which does also support this feature.
[Table 92. LPDMA1/2 channel with peripheral early termination]
This LPDMA support is activated when the channel x is programmed with
LPDMA_CxTR2.PFREQ = 1. Then, the peripheral itself can initiate and request a data
transfer completion, before the LPDMA has transferred the whole block
(seeSection14.4.14 for more details).
[Table 93. Programmed LPDMA1/2 request with peripheral early termination]
